name: ao-tax-overview
description: Angola tax overview for tax year 2026, built from Lei 14/25 (the 2026 State Budget law), the tax codes and the AGT Portal do Contribuinte. Use when someone asks about tax overview in Angola: rates, who is liable, what is taxed, the deadlines on the AGT Calendario Fiscal 2026, the portal menu path for filing, and the penalties the opened sources state. Covers companies, individuals and employers as stated in the scope section. Figures that could not be read in an official source are marked unveri
author: openaccountants
